label: ZULF AX 1H-13C pair
description: Minimal heteronuclear ZULF test system: one 1H coupled to one 13C.

theoretical_spectrum.summary: For true zero field with z-prepolarized preparation and Mz detection, the heteronuclear AX pair shows a strong DC component plus a J line at |J|.
notes: The DC line comes from the part of the initial density operator that commutes with H_J.
The oscillating component produces a line at the singlet-triplet splitting |J| = 140 Hz.
Chemical shifts are set to 0 ppm because they collapse in true ZULF.
